finding: Push-triggered workflow executions could create irregular market snapshots in RPI/research-state tapes and therefore influence temporal maturity/exit selection in research studies.
change: Push executions are now regression-tests only. All market-data probes, captures, study evaluations, and capture-tape publication are restricted to scheduled or explicit workflow_dispatch executions.
expectedImpact: Removes code-change timing as a source of market-sample timing and outcome-label contamination; future durable observations are generated only by the pre-existing scheduled/manual research capture path.
